item.title: Donegal disposable income 18.1% below national average
item.description: CSO figures published this morning show that Donegal had an average disposable income €24,686 per capita in 2024, 18.1% less than the national average. The Donegal figure was the third lowest in the state, with Longford recording the lowest figure at €23,725. item.title: Donegal had the least sunshine in Ireland during January
item.description: Today’s climate statement for January published by Met Éireann has shown that Donegal registered the least amount of sunshine of anywhere in Ireland during the month. Malin Head recorded just 47.8 hours of sunshine through the month which equates to 3.75 hours per day. item.description: The new Moderator of the Presbyterian Church in Ireland is Reverend Richard Kerr. item.title: Major leak repaired in Buncrana water system
item.description: Uisce Éireann’s leak detection crews have located and repaired a significant leak that had been affecting water supply in the Keelogs and Druminor areas of Buncrana. Following extensive investigations, the leak was identified earlier today and repairs have been completed, with normal water supply now restored to all affected customers.
